lines: Tere aane ki jab khabar mehke
Teri khushboo se saara ghar mehke
couplets.en: When word of your coming scents the air, your fragrance fills the house.

lines: Tere aane ki jab khabar mehke

couplets.en: When word of your coming scents the air, your fragrance fills the house.

lines: Shaam mehke tere tasavvur se
Shaam ke baad phir sahar mehke
couplets.en: The thought of you scents the evening, and after evening, the dawn.

lines: Tere aane ki jab khabar mehke

couplets.en: When word of your coming scents the air, your fragrance fills the house.

lines: Raat bhar sochta raha tujhko
Zehn-o-dil mere raat bhar mehke
couplets.en: I thought of you all night, and your fragrance lingered in my heart and mind.

lines: Tere aane ki jab khabar mehke

couplets.en: When word of your coming scents the air, your fragrance fills the house.

lines: Yaad aaye to dil munavvar ho
Deed ho jaaye to nazar mehke
couplets.en: The memory of you lights my heart, and a glimpse of you leaves my eyes fragrant.

lines: Tere aane ki jab khabar mehke
Teri khushboo se saara ghar mehke
couplets.en: When word of your coming scents the air, your fragrance fills the house.

lines: Woh ghadi do ghadi jahaan baithe
Woh zameen mehke, woh shajar mehke
couplets.en: Wherever you sat for a moment or two, the earth and the tree grew fragrant.
